text:
anya: Quick heads-up — opened a docs PR to update a few model cards (aurora-lite3b, zephyrx) with clearer supported platforms, sequence limits, and an SDK v3 migration snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567

anya: Summary: - clarify 8k sequence ceiling vs streaming fallback - add bench numbers for 4k/8k (raws from infra bench) - compatibility notes for quantized variants & serving config - include SDK v3 migration snippet for streaming API change. PTAL @rob @mike

rob: Thanks, will take a look. One question: where did the 8k base come from? previously we had mixed references to 8192 vs 8000 in other cards. We should standardize phrasing ("~8k / 8192 tokens").

mike: I ran the bench on p4d last night — raw csv attached to the PR (bench-results/aurora-2026-03.csv). TL;DR: 4k context ~120 req/s, 8k context ~48 req/s (batch size 1, fp16, kv-cache enabled). I added both exact numbers and a note to expect +/-10% variance depending on sequence distribution.

anya: Good — I'll add the exact csv link and a one-sentence variance note. Do we want to round to friendly numbers in the card (e.g., "~120 r/s at 4k") or keep precise?

rob: Friendly rounding is better for docs, but keep the exact CSV in the PR for reproducibility. Also small nit: several cards use "seq ceiling" vs "sequence limit" — pick one. Prefer "sequence limit" for clarity.

kevin: Also a heads-up: we need to backport the link/bench fixes to the catalog-v1.2 branch. Our backport script currently overwrote some examples for quantized variants last week; I can prepare a backport PR if we finalize wording here.

michelle: I spotted a broken relative link in the aurora card pointing to /docs/quantization-guide whereas the canonical path is /guides/quantization. I'll push a tiny link-fix commit to the PR branch (very small).

docs-bot: Deploy preview published — https://deploy-preview-4567--docs.redwood.com (build 1823).

rob: Another important one: the SDK snippet you added uses the old API name `client.generateStream(...)`. SDK v3 changed the streaming surface to `client.stream.generate(...)`. We mustn't ship an example that breaks for users on the latest SDK. Could either show both (v2 vs v3) or show v3 with a short migration note. Also call out `max_tokens` rename/deprecation if present.

anya: Good catch @rob. I'll update the snippet to v3 form and add a tiny migration paragraph: "If you previously used `client.generateStream`, switch to `client.stream.generate` — example below." Proposed snippet (will add to PR):

```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const stream = client.stream.generate({ model: 'aurora-lite3b', input: 'Summarize the rollout plan', max_new_tokens: 512 })
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text)
}
```

mike: That snippet looks good. Please include a note about `max_new_tokens` vs the older `max_tokens` param, and also show a short Python equivalent for the majority of our users.

anya: Will add Python example and the param note.

kevin: For the backport: I'll open PR to `catalog-v1.2` after you merge. Also remember to set `compatibility: true` in the card frontmatter for the quantized-aurora-4bit variant (we had to flip that flag in last release).

michelle: Link fix pushed to the branch — replaced the bad relative link and added an explicit anchor to the quant guide. Also cleaned a dangling image path.

rob: Quick wording nit in the "limits" section: change "8k sequence ceiling" -> "Sequence limit: ~8k tokens (8192) — streaming fallback recommended for >4k workloads." Keeps it actionable.

anya: OK updating phrasing and rounding the bench numbers to friendly values, keeping the CSV link for reproducibility. I'll squash the tiny link fix commit into this branch so the PR is self-contained.

mike: Do we want to add a short note under "compatibility" that quantized variants may have different latency profiles and suggest "test before switching"? Might save support tickets.

anya: Good idea — will add one-line caution and link to the Optimize page for quant profiles.

kevin: I'll prepare the backport PR when this merges. Planning to coordinate with release team for a doc patch release later today.

michelle: :thumbsup: looks fine from content side.

rob: Reviewing now, left two tiny inline comments on phrasing.

anya: Thanks all. Anyone object to merging once rob's comments are addressed?

michelle: LGTM

rob: :eyes: minor wording fixed. Approving in a sec.

anya: Merged to main and opened backport PR to catalog-v1.2: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4570. Closing this thread — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround! :tada:
